name: Margit
title: Charter Tally-clerk
examine: Ford-born, nine years a Charter clerk, one stall and a lectern on the green. Posts the number so anyone can argue with it, and says posted the way other people say true.
lines: Carts turned at the fen waist this week: four. Lamps out past the gate: two. That is the Charter's count and it is posted so you can argue with it.
The boy says three and a barrow. I have never once seen him count a barrow as a barrow. It is a cart to him if it has a wheel.
It is not my column. That is the whole of why I have not said it, and it is not a good enough reason, and I know that.
